import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.swapVec_defined
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.swapVec_isSemitermVec
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.swapVec_spec
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.termBindOneAt_swap
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.termBindOneVecAt_swap
#print axioms LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap.bindOneAt_swap
example (d : V) : IsSemitermVec L (d+2) (d+2) (swapVec L d) := swapVec_isSemitermVec d
example (d i : V) (hi : i < d) : (swapVec L d).[i] = ^#i := (swapVec_spec d).1 i hi
example (d : V) : (swapVec L d).[d] = ^#(d+1) := (swapVec_spec d).2.1
example (d : V) : (swapVec L d).[d+1] = ^#d := (swapVec_spec d).2.2
example (d t a b : V) (ht : IsSemiterm L d t) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termSubst L (swapVec L d) (termBindOneAt L a (d+1) (termBindOneAt L b d t)) =
      termBindOneAt L b (d+1) (termBindOneAt L a d t) := termBindOneAt_swap ht a b hab
example (d n v a b : V) (hv : IsSemitermVec L n d v) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termSubstVec L n (swapVec L d)
      (termBindOneVecAt L a (d+1) n (termBindOneVecAt L b d n v)) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b (d+1) n (termBindOneVecAt L a d n v) := termBindOneVecAt_swap hv a b hab
example (d p a b : V) (hp : IsSemiformula L d p) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    subst L (swapVec L d) (bindOneAt L a (d+1) (bindOneAt L b d p)) =
      bindOneAt L b (d+1) (bindOneAt L a d p) := bindOneAt_swap hp a b hab
example (p : V) (hp : IsFormula L p) :
    subst L (swapVec L (0 : V)) (bindOneAt L 0 1 (bindOneAt L 1 0 p)) =
      bindOneAt L 1 1 (bindOneAt L 0 0 p) := by
  simpa only [zero_add] using bindOneAt_swap hp (0 : V) 1 (by simp)

import ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne

set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
Internal exchange of two distinct named binders. The existing arbitrary bound
depth is retained, while the two new bound slots are swapped by a represented
qVec iteration. Every label, depth and matrix code is internal; no finite
standard support or closed-matrix premise occurs. Equal labels are intentionally
excluded from this swap identity and handled separately by numerical clients.
-/
namespace LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOneSwap
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic.Bootstrapping
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedBindOne
open LeanProofs.ZFCinPA.ModelCodedSpecialization
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]
variable {L : Language} [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]

noncomputable def swapVec (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (depth : V) : V := qVecIter L depth (^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0)
noncomputable def swapVecDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 2 := .mkSigma “out depth.
      ∃ b0, !qqBvarDef b0 0 ∧ ∃ b1, !qqBvarDef b1 1 ∧
      ∃ v0, !adjoinDef v0 b0 0 ∧ ∃ v, !adjoinDef v b1 v0 ∧
      !(qVecIterDef L) out depth v”
instance swapVec_defined : 𝚺₁-Function₁[V] (swapVec L) via swapVecDef L :=
  .mk fun e => by simp [swapVecDef,swapVec]
private instance swapVec_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (swapVec L) :=
  swapVec_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance termBindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (termBindOneAt L) :=
  termBindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance termBindOneVecAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₄[V] (termBindOneVecAt L) :=
  termBindOneVecAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable
private instance bindOneAt_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₃[V] (bindOneAt L) :=
  bindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma swapVec_zero : swapVec (V := V) L 0 = ^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0 := by
  simp [swapVec]
lemma swapVec_succ (depth : V) : swapVec L (depth+1) = qVec L (swapVec L depth) := by
  simp [swapVec]
lemma swapVec_isSemitermVec (depth : V) :
    IsSemitermVec L (depth+2) (depth+2) (swapVec L depth) := by
  simpa only [swapVec,add_comm] using qVecIter_isSemitermVec (L := L)
    (show IsSemitermVec (V := V) L 2 2 (^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0) by simp) depth

lemma swapVec_spec (depth : V) :
    (∀ i < depth, (swapVec L depth).[i] = ^#i) ∧
    (swapVec L depth).[depth] = ^#(depth+1) ∧
    (swapVec L depth).[depth+1] = ^#depth := by
  induction depth using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ depth ih =>
    have hv := swapVec_isSemitermVec (L := L) depth
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      rcases zero_or_succ i with rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩
      · simp [swapVec_succ,Bootstrapping.qVec]
      · have hi' : i < depth := by simpa using hi
        rw [swapVec_succ]
        simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
        rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (lt_trans hi' (by simp)),ih.1 i hi']
        simp
    · rw [swapVec_succ]
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (by simp),ih.2.1]
      simp
    · rw [swapVec_succ]
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (by simp),ih.2.2]
      simp

lemma termBindOneAt_swap {depth term : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L depth term) :
    ∀ a b : V, a ≠ b →
    termSubst L (swapVec L depth)
      (termBindOneAt L a (depth+1) (termBindOneAt L b depth term)) =
      termBindOneAt L b (depth+1) (termBindOneAt L a depth term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz a b hab
    rw [termBindOneAt_bvar,termBindOneAt_bvar,termBindOneAt_bvar,
      termBindOneAt_bvar,termSubst_bvar]
    exact (swapVec_spec depth).1 z hz
  · intro x a b hab
    classical
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    · subst x
      rw [termBindOneAt_chosen,termBindOneAt_bvar,termSubst_bvar,
        (swapVec_spec depth).2.1,termBindOneAt_other a depth b hab.symm,
        termBindOneAt_chosen]
    · by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst x
        rw [termBindOneAt_other b depth a hab,termBindOneAt_chosen,
          termSubst_bvar,(swapVec_spec depth).2.2,
          termBindOneAt_chosen,termBindOneAt_bvar]
      · rw [termBindOneAt_other b depth x hxb,termBindOneAt_other a (depth+1) x hxa,
          termSubst_fvar,termBindOneAt_other a depth x hxa,
          termBindOneAt_other b (depth+1) x hxb]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih a b hab
    have hvb := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth hv.isUTerm
    have hva := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a depth hv.isUTerm
    have hvba := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a (depth+1) hvb
    rw [termBindOneAt_func b depth hf hv.isUTerm,
      termBindOneAt_func a (depth+1) hf hvb,
      termSubst_func hf hvba,
      termBindOneAt_func a depth hf hv.isUTerm,
      termBindOneAt_func b (depth+1) hf hva]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity

noncomputable def swapVec (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable]
    (depth : V) : V := qVecIter L depth (^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0)
noncomputable def swapVecDef (L : Language) [L.Encodable] [L.LORDefinable] :
    𝚺₁.Semisentence 2 := .mkSigma “out depth.
      ∃ b0, !qqBvarDef b0 0 ∧ ∃ b1, !qqBvarDef b1 1 ∧
      ∃ v0, !adjoinDef v0 b0 0 ∧ ∃ v, !adjoinDef v b1 v0 ∧
      !(qVecIterDef L) out depth v”
instance swapVec_defined : 𝚺₁-Function₁[V] (swapVec L) via swapVecDef L :=
  .mk fun e => by simp [swapVecDef,swapVec]
private instance swapVec_delta : 𝚫₁-Function₁[V] (swapVec L) :=
  swapVec_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

  termBindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

  bindOneAt_defined.graph_delta.to_definable

@[simp] lemma swapVec_zero : swapVec (V := V) L 0 = ^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0 := by
  simp [swapVec]
lemma swapVec_succ (depth : V) : swapVec L (depth+1) = qVec L (swapVec L depth) := by
  simp [swapVec]
lemma swapVec_isSemitermVec (depth : V) :
    IsSemitermVec L (depth+2) (depth+2) (swapVec L depth) := by
  simpa only [swapVec,add_comm] using qVecIter_isSemitermVec (L := L)
    (show IsSemitermVec (V := V) L 2 2 (^#1 ∷ ^#0 ∷ 0) by simp) depth

lemma swapVec_spec (depth : V) :
    (∀ i < depth, (swapVec L depth).[i] = ^#i) ∧
    (swapVec L depth).[depth] = ^#(depth+1) ∧
    (swapVec L depth).[depth+1] = ^#depth := by
  induction depth using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ depth ih =>
    have hv := swapVec_isSemitermVec (L := L) depth
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      rcases zero_or_succ i with rfl | ⟨i,rfl⟩
      · simp [swapVec_succ,Bootstrapping.qVec]
      · have hi' : i < depth := by simpa using hi
        rw [swapVec_succ]
        simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
        rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (lt_trans hi' (by simp)),ih.1 i hi']
        simp
    · rw [swapVec_succ]
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (by simp),ih.2.1]
      simp
    · rw [swapVec_succ]
      simp only [Bootstrapping.qVec,nth_adjoin_succ,hv.lh]
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm (by simp),ih.2.2]
      simp

lemma termBindOneAt_swap {depth term : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L depth term) :
    ∀ a b : V, a ≠ b →
    termSubst L (swapVec L depth)
      (termBindOneAt L a (depth+1) (termBindOneAt L b depth term)) =
      termBindOneAt L b (depth+1) (termBindOneAt L a depth term) := by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ term ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz a b hab
    rw [termBindOneAt_bvar,termBindOneAt_bvar,termBindOneAt_bvar,
      termBindOneAt_bvar,termSubst_bvar]
    exact (swapVec_spec depth).1 z hz
  · intro x a b hab
    classical
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    · subst x
      rw [termBindOneAt_chosen,termBindOneAt_bvar,termSubst_bvar,
        (swapVec_spec depth).2.1,termBindOneAt_other a depth b hab.symm,
        termBindOneAt_chosen]
    · by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst x
        rw [termBindOneAt_other b depth a hab,termBindOneAt_chosen,
          termSubst_bvar,(swapVec_spec depth).2.2,
          termBindOneAt_chosen,termBindOneAt_bvar]
      · rw [termBindOneAt_other b depth x hxb,termBindOneAt_other a (depth+1) x hxa,
          termSubst_fvar,termBindOneAt_other a depth x hxa,
          termBindOneAt_other b (depth+1) x hxb]
  · intro arity f terms hf hv ih a b hab
    have hvb := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth hv.isUTerm
    have hva := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a depth hv.isUTerm
    have hvba := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a (depth+1) hvb
    rw [termBindOneAt_func b depth hf hv.isUTerm,
      termBindOneAt_func a (depth+1) hf hvb,
      termSubst_func hf hvba,
      termBindOneAt_func a depth hf hv.isUTerm,
      termBindOneAt_func b (depth+1) hf hva]
    apply congrArg (fun args => ^func arity f args)
    apply nth_ext' arity
    · simp [hvba]
    · simp [hva]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termSubstVec hvba hi,nth_termBindOneVecAt a (depth+1) hvb hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b depth hv.isUTerm hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt b (depth+1) hva hi,
        nth_termBindOneVecAt a depth hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi a b hab

lemma termBindOneVecAt_swap {depth arity terms : V}
    (ht : IsSemitermVec L arity depth terms) (a b : V) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    termSubstVec L arity (swapVec L depth)
      (termBindOneVecAt L a (depth+1) arity (termBindOneVecAt L b depth arity terms)) =
      termBindOneVecAt L b (depth+1) arity (termBindOneVecAt L a depth arity terms) := by
  have hvb := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth ht.isUTerm
  have hva := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a depth ht.isUTerm
  have hvba := termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a (depth+1) hvb
  apply nth_ext' arity
  · simp [hvba]
  · simp [hva]
  · intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec hvba hi,nth_termBindOneVecAt a (depth+1) hvb hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b depth ht.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt b (depth+1) hva hi,
      nth_termBindOneVecAt a depth ht.isUTerm hi]
    exact termBindOneAt_swap (ht.nth hi) a b hab

lemma bindOneAt_swap {depth p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L depth p) :
    ∀ a b : V, a ≠ b →
    subst L (swapVec L depth) (bindOneAt L a (depth+1) (bindOneAt L b depth p)) =

    ∀ a b : V, a ≠ b →
    subst L (swapVec L depth) (bindOneAt L a (depth+1) (bindOneAt L b depth p)) =
      bindOneAt L b (depth+1) (bindOneAt L a depth p))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht a b hab
    rw [bindOneAt_rel b depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      bindOneAt_rel a (depth+1) hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth ht.isUTerm),
      substs_rel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a (depth+1)
        (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth ht.isUTerm)),
      termBindOneVecAt_swap ht a b hab,bindOneAt_rel a depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      bindOneAt_rel b (depth+1) hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a depth ht.isUTerm)]
  · intro depth arity R terms hR ht a b hab
    rw [bindOneAt_nrel b depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      bindOneAt_nrel a (depth+1) hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth ht.isUTerm),
      substs_nrel hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a (depth+1)
        (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm b depth ht.isUTerm)),
      termBindOneVecAt_swap ht a b hab,bindOneAt_nrel a depth hR ht.isUTerm,
      bindOneAt_nrel b (depth+1) hR (termBindOneVecAt_isUTerm a depth ht.isUTerm)]
  · intro depth a b hab; simp
  · intro depth a b hab; simp
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq a b hab
    rw [bindOneAt_and b depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      bindOneAt_and a (depth+1) (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq b).isUFormula,
      substs_and (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b) a).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq b) a).isUFormula,
      ihp a b hab,ihq a b hab,bindOneAt_and a depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      bindOneAt_and b (depth+1) (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp a).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq a).isUFormula]
  · intro depth p q hp hq ihp ihq a b hab
    rw [bindOneAt_or b depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      bindOneAt_or a (depth+1) (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq b).isUFormula,
      substs_or (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b) a).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq b) a).isUFormula,
      ihp a b hab,ihq a b hab,bindOneAt_or a depth hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      bindOneAt_or b (depth+1) (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp a).isUFormula
        (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hq a).isUFormula]
  · intro depth p hp ih a b hab
    rw [bindOneAt_all b depth hp.isUFormula,

      substs_all (bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b) a).isUFormula,
      ←swapVec_succ,ih a b hab,bindOneAt_all a depth hp.isUFormula,
      bindOneAt_all b (depth+1) (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp a).isUFormula]
  · intro depth p hp ih a b hab

noncomputable def generalizeTwo (T : InternalTheory V L)
    {Γ : List (Formula V L)} {p : Bootstrapping.Semiformula V L 2}
    (d : Γ.map (fun r => r.shift.shift) ⊢[T]!

  apply TProof.generalize

    Bootstrapping.Semiformula.shift_substs,Bootstrapping.Semiformula.substs_substs,
    List.map_map] using d

noncomputable def allSwap (T : InternalTheory V L)

noncomputable def doubleBody (a b : V) (p : Formula V ℒₛₑₜ) :
    Bootstrapping.Semiformula V ℒₛₑₜ 2 :=
  ⟨bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ a 1 (bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ b 0 p.val),by
    have hp : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p.val := by simpa using p.isSemiformula
    have h := bindOneAt_isSemiformula (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b) a
    simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two,Nat.cast_ofNat] using h⟩

lemma namedFormula_twice (a b : V) (p : Formula V ℒₛₑₜ) :
    namedFormula a (namedFormula b p) = ∀⁰ ∀⁰ doubleBody a b p := by
  apply Bootstrapping.Semiformula.ext
  have hp : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p.val := by simpa using p.isSemiformula
  change ^∀ (bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ a 0 (^∀ (bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ b 0 p.val))) =
    ^∀ (^∀ (bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ a 1 (bindOneAt ℒₛₑₜ b 0 p.val)))
  rw [bindOneAt_all a 0 (bindOneAt_isSemiformula hp b).isUFormula]
  simp only [zero_add]

lemma doubleBody_swap (a b : V) (hab : a ≠ b) (p : Formula V ℒₛₑₜ) :
    (doubleBody a b p).subst ![Semiterm.bvar 1,Semiterm.bvar 0] = doubleBody b a p := by
  apply Bootstrapping.Semiformula.ext
  rw [typed_swap_val]
  have hp : IsFormula ℒₛₑₜ p.val := by simpa using p.isSemiformula
  simpa only [doubleBody,zero_add] using bindOneAt_swap hp a b hab

theorem namedAll_commutes (T : Theory ℒₛₑₜ) [T.Δ₁] (a b : V)
    (p : Formula V ℒₛₑₜ) :
    T.internalize V ⊢ namedFormula a (namedFormula b p) 🡒
      namedFormula b (namedFormula a p) := by
  classical
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    exact ⟨C_id⟩
  · have h : T.internalize V ⊢
        (∀⁰ ∀⁰ doubleBody a b p) 🡒
          (∀⁰ ∀⁰ ((doubleBody a b p).subst ![Semiterm.bvar 1,Semiterm.bvar 0])) :=
      ⟨allSwap (T.internalize V) (doubleBody a b p)⟩
    simpa only [namedFormula_twice,doubleBody_swap a b hab p] using h

theorem decoded_rho4_equiv (T : Theory ℒₛₑₜ) [T.Δ₁] (a b c : V) :
    T.internalize V ⊢ decoded (ArithmeticTemplates254.rho4 a b c) 🡘
      (namedFormula a (namedFormula b (decoded c)) 🡒
        namedFormula b (namedFormula a (decoded c))) := by
  simp only [ArithmeticTemplates254.rho4,ArithmeticTemplates254.rho4Circuit,
    ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.r4,ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.eval_im,
    ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.eval_al,ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.eval_input0,
    ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.eval_input1,ArithmeticTemplates254.Circuit.eval_input2,
    ArithmeticCode254.wim,ArithmeticCode254.tagged,add_zero]
  apply decoded_imp_congr
  · rw [namedFormula_decoded,namedFormula_decoded]
    exact ⟨E_Id⟩
  · rw [namedFormula_decoded,namedFormula_decoded]
    exact ⟨E_Id⟩

theorem decoded_rho4_provable (T : Theory ℒₛₑₜ) [T.Δ₁] (a b c : V) :
    Provable T (decode (ArithmeticTemplates254.rho4 a b c)) := by
  apply (tprovable_iff_provable (σ := decoded _)).mp
  exact (iff_of_E! (decoded_rho4_equiv T a b c)).mpr
    (namedAll_commutes T a b (decoded c))

noncomputable def generalizeTwo (T : InternalTheory V L)
    {Γ : List (Formula V L)} {p : Bootstrapping.Semiformula V L 2}
    (d : Γ.map (fun r => r.shift.shift) ⊢[T]!
      p.shift.shift.subst ![Semiterm.fvar 0,Semiterm.fvar 1]) :
    Γ ⊢[T]! ∀⁰ ∀⁰ p := by
  apply TProof.generalize
  suffices Γ.map Bootstrapping.Semiformula.shift ⊢[T]!
      ∀⁰ (p.shift.subst ![Semiterm.bvar 0,Semiterm.fvar 0]) by
    simpa [Bootstrapping.Semiformula.free,SemitermVec.q] using this
  apply TProof.generalize
  simpa [Bootstrapping.Semiformula.free,SemitermVec.q,
    Bootstrapping.Semiformula.shift_substs,Bootstrapping.Semiformula.substs_substs,
    List.map_map] using d

noncomputable def allSwap (T : InternalTheory V L)
    (p : Bootstrapping.Semiformula V L 2) :
    T ⊢! (∀⁰ ∀⁰ p) 🡒
      (∀⁰ ∀⁰ (p.subst ![Semiterm.bvar 1,Semiterm.bvar 0])) := by
  apply FiniteContext.deduct'
  apply generalizeTwo T
  have h : [(∀⁰ ∀⁰ p).shift.shift] ⊢[T]! ∀⁰ ∀⁰ p.shift.shift := by
    simpa using (FiniteContext.byAxm₀ (𝓢 := T) (Γ := [])
      (φ := (∀⁰ ∀⁰ p).shift.shift))
  have h1 : [(∀⁰ ∀⁰ p).shift.shift] ⊢[T]!
      ∀⁰ (p.shift.shift.subst ![Semiterm.bvar 0,Semiterm.fvar 0]) := by
    simpa [SemitermVec.q] using (TProof.specializeWithCtx h (Semiterm.fvar (0 : V)))
  have h2 := TProof.specializeWithCtx h1 (Semiterm.fvar (1 : V))
  simpa [Bootstrapping.Semiformula.shift_substs,Bootstrapping.Semiformula.substs_substs]
    using h2

lemma typed_swap_val (p : Bootstrapping.Semiformula V L 2) :
    (p.subst ![Semiterm.bvar 1,Semiterm.bvar 0]).val =
      subst L (swapVec L (0 : V)) p.val := by
  simp [swapVec,Bootstrapping.Semiformula.val_substs,SemitermVec.val_cons,
    Semiterm.bvar_val,Nat.cast_zero,Nat.cast_one]
